name: Beard brush / comb
lead: Beard brushes and combs are grooming tools used to detangle, shape and distribute product through facial hair. Some beard-growers also describe brushing as "training" the hair to lie in a direction.
Combs date back to prehistoric times, per Wikipedia, though its article does not cover beard combs specifically.[1] No studies of beard brushing for appearance or growth were found.

paras: Combs have long histories across regions, with unbreakable plastic versions introduced in the mid-20th century and artisan combs of varied materials becoming popular more recently.[1] Beard-specific variants are sold commercially.
Proponents say brushing tidies and shapes the beard and may make it look fuller; these claims are anecdotal.

timeline.event: Combs in use since prehistoric times.[1]

card.summary: Brush or comb for tidying and shaping a beard; no evidence it changes growth.

quick.overview:
Tools for detangling and shaping facial hair.

Some users say brushing helps train hair direction.
quick.mechanism: Bristles or teeth align and spread hairs; no research shows an effect on follicle growth.
quick.risks: No notable risks are documented; vigorous use can irritate skin.
